title: Humpback Recovery Turned 450 Whales Into 25,000
closing: Protecting wildlife can reverse losses that once looked permanent.
question: Which recovery should happen next?

segments.say: Humpbacks rebounded to 25,000. Protection turned near-collapse into a regional comeback.
10 humpback populations are fully recovered. Conservation can move entire groups off the endangered list.
Commercial whaling killed 2.9 million whales. The ban removed the pressure that had crushed their numbers.
